records.reason: Controlled studies already report respiratory/cardiovascular and HRV changes during rosary/mantra recitation, chanting and structured singing. The differentiating proposition is not that recitation changes physiology; it is whether semantic significance has a residual preregistered effect after respiration, acoustics, effort, familiarity and expectation are controlled.

Primary studies show neural electromagnetic recordings are modulated by semantic context, and externally applied electromagnetic fields can be separately studied. Neither observation establishes that a word generates a semantically specific external electromagnetic causal channel independent of neural/sensory/respiratory/hemodynamic/endocrine pathways.
records.next: do not promote without physical field model, magnitude/spectrum estimates, sham/blinding, ordinary-pathway isolation and independent replication
